objective: Proof: bond distance is a metric on every base whose bonds compose like cycles (parity bases); the smallest failures under not-all-equal and the clause; the three-place laws giving a metric on every base.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): where the bonds of a base compose like cycles (every parity base), bond distance and bond distance minus one satisfy the triangle inequality; each of the eight non-parity languages of three-place laws passing K1-K3 has a base where bond distance fails it (not-all-equal: two knots sharing two distinctions, no bond holds their thirds); so among the 34 three-place laws bond distance is a metric on every base of copies of one law exactly for parity.
title: Where bond distance is a metric
